signal: Placer.ai partnered with CRED iQ in April 2026 to bring location analytics to commercial mortgage-backed securities, extending into a new financial-services vertical

email.body1:
Hal, saw Placer.ai team up with CRED iQ to push location analytics into CMBS.

A new vertical like that floods the queue with accounts faster than any rep can research and follow up on by hand, and that is where good leads go stale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three CMBS-side accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Hal, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

As an SDR opening a new vertical, the slow part is rarely the talking, it is the research, writing, and follow-up volume between each touch. That work quietly caps how many accounts you can actually keep warm in a week.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Hal, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other SDRs at growth-stage firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Hal, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting research and follow-up time is not a priority right now, no problem at all. Opening a new vertical is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
